name: Brisk Walking

instructions.description: Stand tall and begin walking at a comfortable pace to warm up.
Gradually increase your speed until your breathing is deeper but conversation is still possible.
Swing your arms naturally and keep your stride smooth rather than overreaching.
Slow down gradually at the end instead of stopping abruptly.

performanceMetrics.notes: Typically moderate intensity for many adults.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Alternate faster and easier segments for a stronger conditioning stimulus.

commentsNotes: Maintain an upright posture and relaxed shoulders.
Use supportive footwear and a safe walking surface.
